overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Board never entered the December 2 executive session, and the December 9 joint session properly invoked Purpose 6 to protect a solar lease negotiating position. Reminders on minutes release were given, but no orders issued.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board improperly planned an executive session on December 2 to discuss the solar project without a proper statutory purpose.
allegations.key_passage: Since the Board postponed its December 2 executive session until it could meet jointly with the Commission, we find no violation of the Open Meeting Law regarding the December 2 executive session, as the Board did not enter executive session.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board and Commission improperly met in a December 9 joint executive session about the solar project without a proper statutory purpose.
allegations.key_passage: We are satisfied that the Board and Commission’s discussion regarding the solar project was proper under Purpose 6 as the discussion related to the “purchase, exchange, lease or value” of property and the Board had a negotiating position to protect in its ongoing negotiations with the energy company.
